thread.title: Short Interest in Apple (AAPL) Expands By 14.5%

author: Patrick Bannon
title: Short Interest in Apple (AAPL) Expands By 14.5%
text:
Tweet 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) saw a significant growth in short interest in the month of March. As of March 15th, there was short interest totalling 67,276,061 shares, a growth of 14.5% from the February 28th total of 58,730,906 shares. Currently, 1.3% of the shares of the stock are short sold. Based on an average daily trading volume, of 31,193,352 shares, the days-to-cover ratio is presently 2.2 days. 
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $167.78 on Friday. The firm has a market cap of $854,159.38, a P/E ratio of 17.24, a PEG ratio of 1.28 and a beta of 1.19. Apple has a twelve month low of $140.06 and a twelve month high of $183.50. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Get Apple alerts: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period last year, the business earned $3.36 EPS. equities analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current year. Several analysts have issued reports on the stock. Nomura reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $175.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, March 19th. Goldman Sachs reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $159.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. BidaskClub downgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a report on Friday, January 26th. BMO Capital Markets downgraded shares of Apple from an “outperform” rating to a “market perform” rating and upped their price target for the company from $162.00 to $166.00 in a report on Wednesday, January 31st. Finally, William Blair reaffirmed an “outperform” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, February 2nd. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $202.62.
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . Corporate insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
A number of hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently bought and sold shares of the business. BlackRock Inc. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 1.0% in the 4th quarter. BlackRock Inc. now owns 319,715,585 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $54,105,468,000 after buying an additional 3,048,055 shares during the last quarter. Berkshire Hathaway Inc. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 0.6% in the 2nd quarter. Berkshire Hathaway Inc. now owns 130,191,960 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $18,750,246,000 after buying an additional 834,854 shares during the last quarter. Geode Capital Management LLC lifted its position in shares of Apple by 2.5% in the 4th quarter. Geode Capital Management LLC now owns 56,447,158 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $9,533,267,000 after buying an additional 1,356,879 shares during the last quarter. Bank of New York Mellon Corp lifted its position in shares of Apple by 0.7% in the 4th quarter. Bank of New York Mellon Corp now owns 53,301,694 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $9,020,245,000 after buying an additional 360,312 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Capital Research Global Investors lifted its position in shares of Apple by 15.0% in the 2nd quarter. Capital Research Global Investors now owns 29,449,961 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,241,383,000 after buying an additional 3,845,363 shares during the last quarter. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 61.35% of the company’s stock. 
Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
